description: Defines the UploadedFile class implementing the UploadedFileInterface for handling uploaded files within the Laminas Diactoros PSR-7 implementation, including error handling, moving files, and providing a stream interface.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 UploadedFileInterface, managing uploaded file data, including error states, moving files securely, and providing access to the file stream.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream representing the uploaded file; throws exception if upload error occurred or file already moved.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, handling different PHP SAPI environments and ensuring target directory is writable.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes, or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the PHP upload error code associated with this uploaded file.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client.
